sections.whatsHappening: You and the other parties must serve and file documents at different stages. At least 14 days before the settlement conference, each party must serve on every other party and file with the court a copy of any document to be relied on at the trial, including an expert report, not attached to the party's claim or defence. You must also serve and file a list of proposed witnesses (Form 13A) and of other persons with knowledge of the matters in dispute. A document served at least 30 days before the trial date shall be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatToDoNext: Serve your documents on the other parties and file them with the court as required. You can serve the documents yourself or have someone else do it for you. Make sure to keep detailed notes of the service, including the name of the person served, the date, time, and manner of service. This information will be needed for an affidavit of service.
sections.whatHappensAfter: After serving and filing your documents, they will be part of the court record. The other parties will have the opportunity to review them and prepare their responses. If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial, it will be received in evidence unless the judge decides otherwise.
